shape: skyynet-master-planning#36's sidecar SHAPE — five (claim, verbatim span, SHA-pinned URL) rows over four sources, one source quoted twice — with every byte FABRICATED for this fixture. No third-party file is redistributed here: the repo is public, and the mechanism under test (sidecar → capture → content store → offline verify) needs bytes that contain the quoted spans, not the bytes any real URL served. The end-to-end proof on real citations is a live research run, not this.
sha: each row's `sha` is the sha1 of its synthetic file, standing in for the commit a real row pins; the URL host is RFC 2606's reserved `.invalid`, so nothing here can resolve on a network by accident
sha256: sha256 of each plain-text file; `_bytes_for` refuses a file that no longer matches
